lines: Uske honton pe mera naam jab aaya hoga
couplets.en: My name must have come to her lips.

lines: Khud ko ruswai se phir kaise bachaya hoga
couplets.en: How did she spare herself the shame?

lines: Sun ke auron se fasana meri barbadi ka
couplets.en: She heard the story of my ruin from others.

lines: Kya use apna sitam yaad na aaya hoga
couplets.en: Did she remember how cruel she had been?

lines: Main gham ke ghar mein qaid hoon, beghar nahin hoon main
couplets.en: Grief holds me captive and gives me a home.

lines: Thokar na yun laga mujhe, patthar nahin hoon main
couplets.en: Do not kick me aside like a stone.

lines: Main gham ke ghar mein qaid hoon, beghar nahin hoon main
couplets.en: Grief holds me captive and gives me a home.

lines: Main gham ke ghar mein qaid hoon
couplets.en: I am a prisoner in the house of grief.

lines: Kis shauq se dekhte ho tum meri tabahi ko
couplets.en: How eagerly you watch me come to ruin.

lines: Thokar na yun laga mujhe, patthar nahin hoon main
couplets.en: Do not kick me aside like a stone.

lines: Aaj charcha to hai mera saare shahr mein
couplets.en: Today the whole city speaks of me.

lines: Afsos, ek teri zaban par nahin hoon main
couplets.en: Yours are the only lips I wish would speak my name.

lines: Thokar na yun laga mujhe, patthar nahin hoon main
couplets.en: Do not kick me aside like a stone.

lines: Main gham ke ghar mein qaid hoon, beghar nahin hoon main
couplets.en: Grief holds me captive and gives me a home.

lines: Aandhiyan gham ki chalengi to bikhar jaunga
couplets.en: When the winds of grief rise, I will scatter.

lines: Main to dariya hoon, samandar mein utar jaunga
couplets.en: I am a river on my way to the sea.

lines: Mujh ko sooli pe chadhane ki zarurat kya hai
couplets.en: What need is there to put me on the gallows?

lines: Mere haathon se qalam chheen lo, mar jaunga
couplets.en: Take the pen from my hands and I will die.

lines: Aankhon ke is tarazu mein tu mujh ko tol dekh
couplets.en: Weigh me in the scales of your eyes.

lines: Khuddar lakh hoon agar, khudsar nahin hoon main
couplets.en: For all my pride, I can still bend.

lines: Patthar nahin hoon main
couplets.en: I am no stone.

lines: Main gham ke ghar mein qaid hoon, beghar nahin hoon main
couplets.en: Grief holds me captive and gives me a home.

lines: Main gham ke ghar mein qaid hoon
couplets.en: I am a prisoner in the house of grief.

lines: Ab apne aap ko bhi mayassar nahin hoon main
couplets.en: Now even I cannot reach myself.

couplets.en: Do not kick me aside like a stone.
